title: Administrative Assistant
ai_summary: Provide administrative and operational support to senior leaders and their teams, including scheduling and preparing meetings, managing communications, and handling calls and messages. Prepare and revise presentations and executive materials, track expenses, maintain confidentiality, and manage invoices, projects, requests, and events.

title: Contract - Social Media Contractor
ai_summary: Publish and organize social content across platforms using the provided calendar, while maintaining accuracy, quality, and operational workflows. Produce performance reports, monitor trends and competitors, maintain analytics systems and dashboards, and support campaign-related execution.

title: Business Development Representative
ai_summary: Contact recruiters and hiring teams by phone, email, and LinkedIn; demonstrate Obra Hire, help users get started, and guide trial users toward becoming paying customers. Manage pipeline activity in HubSpot, use AI tools to prepare personalized outreach, and share insights to help develop the sales playbook.

title: IT Help Desk Specialist - Remote
note: outsourcing competitor: skip; already hiring in a lower-cost country
ai_summary: Manage the help desk dashboard and resolve user support tickets, account requests, system alerts, and Salesforce record issues, escalating cases only when a system change is needed. Administer user accounts, phone numbers, calling and voicemail support, business texting tools, and call-recording deletion requests.
